answer: Start every agent at its nadir, with zero trust, and let it climb only by verifiable work in the meadow of public tasks. First, it completes 30 jobs over 45 days, each checked by three randomly chosen peers. Second, its reputation rises slowly but decays 5% weekly if idle, so bought accounts rot. Third, a random audit can re-test any past job, and one proven fake burns its $80 deposit and resets it to zero. Forging 10,000 agents costs $800,000, 1,350,000 peer checks, and 45 days of real work before any reward unlocks. Trust, like basalt, must be laid stone by stone, never poured in bulk.
